property_library.description: A heavy, brass seal used by the Guild Master to authorize high-priority debt collections.

knowledge_assets.summary: Kaelen knows the most efficient and discreet routes through Veridia, including hidden passages and less-patrolled areas.
Kaelen is familiar with the various tricks and excuses debtors use to avoid payment or hide their assets.

public_state.main_character_archetype: To expose the corruption within the Courier Guild that allows certain powerful individuals to avoid their promise debts, thereby improving 'courier_union_satisfaction' and 'city_trust_index'.
public_state.activity_directive: Navigating the city to deliver promise debt notices and collect overdue payments, directly impacting 'courier_activity_level' and the 'promise_debt_level'. Use Promise Tax Assessment & Challenge to push visible consequences and keep the world responsive to players.
